item.title: USCIS changes filing deadlines that fall on a weekend or holiday starting October 23, 2026
item.description: From October 23, only deadlines counted in days move to the next business day. Age or status-expiration cutoffs do not. What changes and what to do.

item.title: USCIS change of address (AR-11): how to do it online and not miss your mail
item.description: If you moved, tell USCIS within 10 days. How to change your address online, why USPS forwarding is not enough, and what to do with pending cases.

item.title: My USCIS case is not moving: is that normal? How to check processing times
item.description: Many cases spend months in "Case Is Being Actively Reviewed". How to know if yours is within normal times and what to do if not.

item.title: USCIS receipt number: what the 3 letters mean (IOE, EAC, WAC, LIN, SRC, MSC)
item.description: Your receipt number has 3 letters and 10 digits. The letters tell you which USCIS office or system has your case.

item.title: I got an RFE from USCIS: what it is and what to do, step by step
item.description: A Request for Evidence (RFE) is not a denial. It is USCIS asking for more documents. How to answer well and on time.

item.title: USCIS finalizes the end of the 540-day automatic EAD extension
item.description: If you filed your work permit renewal (I-765) on or after October 30, 2025, your EAD no longer extends automatically. What changed and what to do.

item.title: USCIS proposes ending deference to prior approvals for work visa extensions
item.description: Proposed rule of October 14, 2026: extensions (H-1B, L-1 and others) would be reviewed from scratch. Comments due November 13, 2026.

item.title: October 2026 Visa Bulletin: EB-2 moves forward strongly for Rest of World
item.description: For employment-based adjustment, USCIS uses the Dates for Filing chart. EB-2 Rest of World: March 15, 2026. EB-1 Rest of World: current.
